I'm an assistant professor of statistics at [Copenhagen Business School](https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/departments/department-finance/center-statistics). My research interests include graphical models and causal inference, and my current work is focused on causal discovery.

Previously, I was a postdoc at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen, where I was a part of the [Copenhagen Causality Lab](https://cocala.github.io/). Before that, I was a PhD student in the [Statistical Methods for Causal Inference](https://www.bips-institut.de/en/the-institute/departments/statistical-methods-in-epidemiology/statistical-methods-for-causal-inference.html) group at the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology - BIPS in Bremen.

My email address is cwb (dot) fi (at) cbs (dot) dk.
